sources.title: Gradescope: Creating a Programming Assignment
sources.claims: Programming Assignments require an institutional license; create from the course Assignments page; mobile-app upload is unsupported.

sources.title: Gradescope: Multiple submissions
sources.claims: Most recent student upload is active by default; previous submissions remain in history; submission dates apply.

sources.title: U.S. Department of Education: FERPA
sources.claims: Institutional obligations govern access to and disclosure of education records. Follow institutional privacy and retention requirements; the guide is not a compliance guarantee.
